mentions.name: Vinaa
mentions.description: A macOS app that keeps all your AI chats in one place so you can go back and search them easily. Built for people who code with Claude Code and Codex but don't want their regular chats scattered across those apps.
mentions.problem: AI chats are scattered across coding tools like Claude Code and Codex, making them hard to keep and search later; the author wanted one place to store and search all chats.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on my 2nd macOS app - https://www.vinaa.ai/

I use Claude Code and Codex for coding but don't want my regular chats in those apps. I prefer to keep all my chats in one place so I can go back and search easily, that is why I built Vinaa.
mentions.author: sujee

mentions.name: Vinaa
mentions.description: This app is an AI chat application for macOS that treats chat as a first-class citizen, deliberately separate from coding/work apps. It differentiates from other similar apps through user experience and performance, and is free during beta.
mentions.problem: Existing desktop AI apps combine coding/work and chat in a single app, while the author believes these are two different things that need different dedicated apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Vinaa, an AI chat application for macOS. https://www.vinaa.ai/
mentions.author: sujee

mentions.name: Vinaa
mentions.description: A native Mac app for AI chats that supports cloud models via the user's own API keys as well as local models. Chats can be organized into projects and folders, used across multiple windows and tabs, extended with MCP tools, and synced via iCloud.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on Vinaa, a native Mac app for AI chats. It works with cloud models using your own API keys, as well as local models.

You can organize chats into projects and folders, use multiple windows and tabs, connect MCP tools, and sync everything via iCloud.
mentions.author: sujee
